ballPolicy: Moxie-specific separately rendered ball rises from chest to her release palm at pose5/tick13, then travels out of frame. No ball is painted into any pose.

review.reviewNotes: Ten distinct complete right-facing adult human jump-shot poses. Moxie’s pale skin, lavender eyes, long high ponytail with gold tie, purple/silver uniform and purple shoes match both supplied canon references. No basketball appears. Pose5 is the only release at tick13; all bodies and ponytails fit their cells.
